notes: LaunchToken is Verdict (VERDICT). Tribunal is the sole application and holds prediction-market bonds and bets in VERDICT. Its constructor arguments are the launch owner, Ethereum Intake v2, IMD payment asset, right-padded bytes32 oracle.request@oracle-1 action, 0.5 IMD in minor units, and the published oracle signer. The signer matches the attester returned by https://api.imd.fun/oracle/requests?limit=1 on 2026-10-12. After deployment, the owner must set the actual LaunchToken address once through setVerdictToken before markets can be created; the factory makes no initialization calls. Subsequent signer changes, and Intake, action or payment changes, require a 48-hour delay and a permissionless activation call; existing markets retain their snapshotted signer and oracle configuration. The owner has no administrative withdrawal or market-resolution function. Tribunal's settlement charge is separate from the pool's 1.25% trading fee. The factory supplies the pool and MerkleDistributor, including the initialization-only pool guard. Source publication, signed artifact linkage, admission and deployment are subsequent service responsibilities.
